@everyone
Charity stream for the Linden Community Pantry: Saturday, Nov 21, 10am–10pm. Goal is $600. Rook is matching the first $100, so early donations count double. Donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz — it goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off. Through their wholesale partner, $1 = about 4 lbs of food. They're serving ~340 families a week and shelves are low before Thanksgiving.

Posting this early because last year half the server found out day-of and we raised $212. No pressure if you can't donate — every bit helps, even $3. If you can't give, you can still help by joining lobbies, voting on games, sharing the link, or dropping canned/boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry's side door Saturdays 9–1.

Incentives from the mods, because apparently this is not begging if I suffer:
$100 — full round with controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color, done on stream
$400 — one hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry

Schedule: first half community lobbies (anyone can join, I'll drop codes), second half chat votes on the game every 2 hrs. No repeat maps, Larry. If you don't have a card, you can still help — join, vote, share, or bring food to the bin. Let's get the pantry stocked.
